title_zh: 《黄岩岛国家级自然保护区管理办法》发布：建立黄岩岛保护区日常巡护制度
title_en: Measures for Huangyan Island National Nature Reserve Issued, Establishing Routine Patrol System
summary_zh: 2026年8月1日，发布《黄岩岛国家级自然保护区管理办法》，建立日常巡护制度，加强黄岩岛生态保护与主权维护。
summary_en: On August 1, 2026, the Measures for Huangyan Island National Nature Reserve were issued, establishing a routine patrol system to enhance ecological protection and sovereignty maintenance.
